info.name: Hermes API
info.description:
## Hermes AI Agent — API collection

Two services:

1. **Main API** (`{{base_url}}`, default `http://localhost:5000`) — chat agent, conversations, attachments, documents/RAG, memories, meeting copilot, connections, voice, businesses, bills. No built-in auth — secure it at the network/CORS/reverse-proxy layer before exposing it publicly.
2. **Ingestion Service** (`{{ingestion_url}}`, default `http://localhost:5100`) — standalone autopilot worker that syncs Gmail/Drive/etc into pgvector and exposes a protected RAG search endpoint. Every route except `/api/health` requires `X-Cron-Secret: {{cron_secret}}` OR `Authorization: Bearer {{cron_secret}}` (or `{{internal_api_token}}`).

### Businesses (`entity_id` / `business`)

Almost every Main API endpoint is scoped by a business slug, or the sentinel `"all"`. Run **Main API → Businesses → List businesses** first — that's the live source of truth. As of the last check, these slugs exist and are Maton-connected:

| slug | name |
|---|---|
| `afk` | Afro Farm Holding |
| `gak` | GAK Properties LLC |
| `gif` | GIF Properties LLC |
| `gakc` | GAK Commodities Ltd |
| `nh` | Nour Hammam LLC |
| `per` | Personal & Family |

Set the `entity_id` collection variable (or the environment variable of the same name) to whichever slug you're testing against.

### Business selection is NOT shared across frontends

The backend has no concept of a globally "current" business — every request must say which business it means via `entity_id`/`business`. The bundled web UI keeps its dropdown selection in browser `localStorage` only. The one exception: once a `session_id` has messages, the server locks *that conversation* to whichever business started it — `GET /api/conversations/{session_id}` returns the authoritative locked value.

### Import

Import this collection plus `Hermes_Local.postman_environment.json`, select the **Hermes Local** environment (top-right dropdown), fill in `cron_secret` if you need the Ingestion Service's protected routes, and go.

item.name: Main API
item.description: http://localhost:5000 — chat, documents, bills, meetings, voice, businesses. No auth by default.

request.description:
Liveness + config-validation check. No params.

**Response**
```json
{ "status": "ok", "problems": [] }
```
`problems` lists any missing/invalid config (e.g. unset API keys) — empty array means fully healthy.

Returns the agent's current LLM platform plus the switchable options.

**Response**
```json
{ "active": "claude", "options": ["claude", "openai"] }
```

Switches the agent's active model platform-wide (affects every conversation, every business), effective on the next turn.

**Body**
- `model` (string, required) — one of the values returned by `Get active model`'s `options`.

400 if `model` isn't a recognized option.

Applies any pending SQL files under `hermes/db/migrations/*.sql` that haven't already run. Idempotent — safe to call repeatedly.

**Response**
```json
{ "applied": ["0012_x.sql"], "already_done": ["0001_init.sql", ...] }
```

body.raw:
{
  "session_id": "{{session_id}}",
  "entity_id": "{{entity_id}}",
  "message": "What's the status of our vacant unit at 2609 15th Ave S?",
  "voice": false,
  "attachment_ids": []
}

request.description:
Runs one user turn through the Claude/OpenAI + Maton agent and returns the full reply (no streaming).

**Body**
- `session_id` (string, optional) — omit to start a new conversation; the response echoes the id to reuse for follow-ups.
- `entity_id` (string, optional) — a business slug (see collection description) or `"all"`. Only used on the FIRST turn of a session — once a session has messages, its business is locked server-side and this is ignored.
- `message` (string) — required unless `attachment_ids` or files are provided.
- `voice` (bool, optional) — if true, response includes synthesized audio metadata for voice mode.
- `attachment_ids` (string[], optional) — ids from a prior `POST /api/attachments` call.

**Response** includes `reply`, `session_id`, `entity_id` (authoritative — the locked business, not just an echo), plus tool-call/thinking traces.

Same as `Chat (JSON, no files)` but multipart/form-data, for attaching new files inline (PDF, image, or text/csv/etc. — anything else is read as text). Add one or more entries under the `files` key. Max request size 25 MB.

Same request shape as `/api/chat` (JSON or multipart). Response is `text/event-stream`, one `data: <json>\n\n` line per event:
- `{"type": "text", "text": "<delta>"}` — reply text as it's generated
- `{"type": "tool_call", "tool": "...", "input": {...}}` — when the agent invokes a tool
- final `{"type": "done", "session_id", "entity_id", "reply", "thinking", "tool_calls", "stop_reason"}`

Postman's response viewer shows raw SSE text — use 'Send' and read the body, it won't render as separate events.

Lists past conversations, newest first.

**Query**
- `entity_id` (optional) — a business slug, or `"all"`/omitted for every business.
- `q` (optional) — free-text search across titles and message content; matches carry a `snippet`.

Each item: `{session_id, title, created_at, updated_at, message_count, snippet, business}`. `created_at`/`updated_at` are **ISO 8601 UTC strings** (e.g. `"2026-07-13T14:32:07.078369+00:00"`) — parse directly with `new Date(created_at)`. `business` is the locked slug, or `null` for an All-Businesses chat.

**Example**
```json
{ "session_id": "8d240890-195b-467d-ae25-95a3ac0c4f46", "title": "...", "created_at": "2026-07-13T14:32:07.078369+00:00", "updated_at": "2026-07-13T14:34:03.508517+00:00", "message_count": 4, "snippet": null, "business": "afk" }
```

Replays one conversation's full transcript (user/assistant turns with thinking + tool traces).

Response's `entity_id` is the AUTHORITATIVE locked business for this session — use it to reseed a UI's business selector on reopen, regardless of what was passed in the query string. 404 if not found.

**Note:** individual turns in `transcript` are `{role, text}` (assistant turns add `thinking`, `tool_calls`) — there is currently NO per-message timestamp, only the conversation-level `created_at`/`updated_at` from `List conversations`. Ask the backend team if you need per-message dates; the DB column exists (`hermes_messages.created_at`) but isn't selected by this endpoint yet.
Deletes a conversation's agent memory AND its history transcript. Irreversible.

Uploads one or more files and returns stable `attachment_id`s to reuse across multiple `/api/chat` calls without re-uploading. Attachments are scoped to `entity_id` — only the same entity can reference or delete them.

**Form fields**
- `files` (required, one or more)
- `entity_id` (optional)
Returns `{filename, type, bytes}` for a previously uploaded attachment. Pass the same `entity_id` it was uploaded with. 404 if not found or wrong entity.
Deletes an attachment. Pass the same `entity_id` it was uploaded with.
Turns an `s3://` URI produced by a tool call (e.g. `wati_get_media`) into a short-lived HTTPS URL for rendering. Only works for URIs inside the app's own configured bucket — otherwise 400.

Ingests files into the semantic-search knowledge base: stores the file (S3, if configured), records it in `documents`, chunks it, embeds it, and writes rows into pgvector.

**Form fields**
- `files` (required, one or more)
- `entity_id` (required) — business slug, or `"all"` to make it a GLOBAL document visible to every business
- `sensitivity_level` (optional, default `internal`)
- `source_system` (optional, default `upload`)
- `message_id` (optional) — links the document to a chat message

**`source_system` — what the Context page's sub-tabs filter on**
- `business_context` — the Files sub-tab: notes and reference documents
- `business_skill` — the Skills sub-tab: reusable markdown playbooks (see `skills/README.md`)

It is a free-form tag affecting listing and provenance only — every document is chunked and embedded identically, so a Skill is reachable through `/api/search` and the agent's `search_business_knowledge` tool like any other.

Lists ingested documents, newest first (omits `body_text` — use the detail endpoint for that).

**Query**
- `entity_id` (required) — business slug, or `"all"` (each row tagged with its `business_slug`)
- `source_system` (optional filter) — `business_context` for the Context page's Files sub-tab, `business_skill` for its Skills sub-tab; omit to list everything

A real `entity_id` returns that business's documents **plus** global (`"all"`) ones, so a business-scoped Skills list includes the global skills.

Every skill the selected business can see — its own plus the global (`"all"`) ones. This is exactly what the Context page's **Skills** sub-tab calls.

Set `entity_id` to `all` to list every business's skills at once, each row tagged with its business.

Saves a markdown SKILL file under one business, or `"all"` for a global skill. Identical to the ingest call above apart from the `business_skill` tag.

The upload filename becomes the document title, so it lands as `My Skill.md` — PATCH the title afterwards to drop the extension (a title-only PATCH does not re-embed).

`scripts/seed_business_skills.py` does all of this in bulk from `skills/MANIFEST.json`.
Full document detail, including `body_text` — for loading into an editor. 404 if not found.
Edits a document's title/sensitivity/content. All fields optional — send only what changes. Editing `body_text` discards and regenerates its chunks/embeddings so search reflects the edit.
Removes a document and its chunks/embeddings (cascade), plus best-effort S3 cleanup of the original file.

Lists persistent memories (owner/business/project scope), newest first.

**Query**
- `entity_id` (optional, default `"all"`) — a business slug, or `"all"` to list across every business plus owner-scope memories
- `scope_type` (optional filter)
Removes one memory. 404 if not found.

Meaning (vector) search scoped to one business's ingested knowledge.

**Query**
- `q` (required) — search text
- `entity_id` (required) — business slug
- `max_sensitivity` (optional, default `internal`) — ceiling on how sensitive returned chunks may be
- `top_k` (optional, default `8`)

{
  "business": "{{entity_id}}",
  "latest_text": "They're asking about the renewal terms.",
  "notes_so_far": "",
  "top_k": 6,
  "session_id": "{{session_id}}",
  "comprehensive": false,
  "meeting_title": "",
  "attendees": []
}

request.description:
Returns short, private, bullet-point guidance for a LIVE meeting, grounded only in what's already been ingested (never scans Gmail/Drive live). Persists the turn to history.

**Body**
- `business` (required) — a SPECIFIC business slug; `"all"` is not allowed here
- `latest_text` / `notes_so_far` — at least one required
- `top_k` (optional, default 6)
- `session_id` (optional) — omit to auto-create on the first turn
- `comprehensive` (optional) — true pulls from all business data, slower
- `meeting_title` / `attendees` — only used when `comprehensive` is true

**Response** `{business, session_id, bullets: [...], sources: [...]}`

Lists meeting sessions, newest first.

**Query**
- `business` (optional) — scope to one business; omit for every business
- `statuses` (optional, comma-separated, e.g. `scheduled,prepared`) — scope to a lifecycle stage
Upcoming calendar events for `business` (required, must be specific), each annotated with its meeting-copilot status if one exists. `days` (optional, default 14) controls the look-ahead window.

Generates an AI pre-meeting brief (background, must-ask questions, risks, relevant already-indexed files) for a calendar event. Creates or idempotently reuses the session for `event_id`.

**Body** — `business`, `event_id`, `title` required; `start` (ISO timestamp), `description`, `attendees` optional.

item.name: Generate AI notes for a session

request.description: Builds (or rebuilds) detailed pre-meeting notes via the full agent — LIVE Gmail/Drive search, not just a vector lookup, so it's slower than `Prepare pre-meeting brief`. Safe to call again to regenerate with fresh results.
Full replay of one meeting: metadata (brief/summary/fathom link/attendees) + every turn, in order. 404 if not found.
Ends a meeting: generates an AI post-meeting summary from its captured turns and best-effort attaches a Fathom recording link if one can be found. Always succeeds even if summary/Fathom lookup fails.
Manually attach/correct a Fathom recording link — the fallback when `End meeting session`'s auto-fetch doesn't find one.
Wipes notes/transcript/guidance for a meeting WITHOUT deleting the session — useful for clearing test content while iterating.
Deletes a meeting session entirely. 404 if not found.

Lists Maton app connections (Gmail, Drive, WATI, etc.) used by the agent's tools.

**Query** — `app` and `status` are both optional filters. 502 if Maton is unreachable.
Starts a new Maton connection for `app` (required). 502 if Maton is unreachable.

Speech → text via the configured provider (OpenAI/Groq Whisper). Send the transcript on to `/api/chat` to run the voice agent.

**Form fields**
- `audio` (required file)
- `entity_id` (optional)
- `context` (optional) — `chat` (default) or `meeting` for ambient room audio

Text → speech. Returns raw audio bytes (not JSON) with the appropriate `Content-Type`.

**Body** — `text` required; `voice` (optional override, see `List voices`); `entity_id` (optional, echoed in the `X-Entity-Id` response header).
Lists TTS voices available for the active provider plus the current default. Response: `{provider, default, voices, enabled}`.
Clears a conversation's in-memory agent history (not its stored transcript — use `Delete conversation` for that). No-op if `session_id` is omitted.

THE source of truth for valid `entity_id`/`business` slugs — always call this first when testing. Each row includes `slug, name, emoji, color, industry, connected` (`connected` = a Maton key is configured for that slug).

**Response**
```json
{ "businesses": [ { "slug": "afk", "name": "Afro Farm Holding", "connected": true }, ... ] }
```

Upserts a business (matches on `slug` if `business_id` is omitted).

**Body** — `name`, `slug` required; `emoji`, `color`, `industry`, `business_id` optional.

Lists bills, plus `insights` (aggregate stats) in the same response.

**Query** — `business_id`, `status`, `source` all optional filters. Note: `business_id` here, unlike most endpoints, is the `businesses` table id/slug used by the Bills feature specifically.

Uploads bill files → runs them through NuExtract → stores structured records. Auto-guesses the business from vendor/category if `business_id` is omitted.

**Form fields** — `files` (required, one or more); `business_id` (optional).

Partial update of a bill. All fields optional — send only what changes: `business_id, status, vendor, amount, invoice_number, due_date, category, notes`. Setting `business_id` also sets `confidence` to 1.0 (manual assignment). 404 if not found.
Permanently deletes a bill and its line items, and removes the original file from S3 if one was stored. 404 if not found.
Aggregate bill stats across all businesses (same object embedded in `List bills`).

Returns a short-lived URL to view the original bill document: a presigned S3 GET (15 min) for uploaded files, a Drive `webViewLink`, or a Gmail deep link for bills with no attachment. 404 if there's no document.

Fetches the decoded HTML/plain-text body of a Gmail-sourced bill on demand via Maton (nothing is cached in the DB). Only works for bills with `source = "gmail"`. Response `{"type": "html"|"text", "content": "..."}`.

Scans ONE business's own Gmail and/or Drive for new bills — scans exactly one business per call by design (fanning out across every business risks a platform timeout).

**Body** — `business` (optional, defaults to `"per"`); `sources` (optional, default `["gmail", "google-drive"]`); `days` (optional, default 45 — use 45 for initial backfill, 7 for recurring scans, capped 1–365). 400 if the business has no Maton connection configured.
Searches Gmail for payment-confirmation emails and auto-marks matching bills as paid. Response `{marked_paid: [...bill_ids], count}`.

item.name: Ingestion Service
item.description: http://localhost:5100 — standalone autopilot sync worker + protected RAG search. Every route below except Health requires X-Cron-Secret or Authorization: Bearer.

request.description: Public, no auth required. Response: `{service, version, ok, problems, connected_businesses, sources, worker_auth_configured, blocked_entities, phi_guard}`.

Runs the autopilot sync for one business (a slug, required). `sources`/`lookback_days`/`max_items` optional overrides; `force` bypasses incremental-sync skip logic. 404 unknown business, 409 if not Maton-connected.
Runs the autopilot sync for every connected business. Same optional fields as `Sync one business`, minus `business`/`sources`/`max_items`.
Rebuilds embeddings for already-ingested items of one business (a slug, required). `limit` caps how many items are reprocessed (default 1000). 404 unknown business.
Indexes one arbitrary text item outside the normal sync sources. `business` and `text` required; everything else optional (auto-generates `source_ref` from a hash of `text` if omitted).

The fast read path for RAG retrieval — same underlying index as the Main API's `GET /api/search`, but as a protected POST for service-to-service calls. Never serves `restricted`-sensitivity content regardless of `max_sensitivity`. `business` and `query` required; `source_systems` optionally filters to e.g. `['gmail','google-drive','fathom']`. 404 unknown business.

GET variant of `Sync all businesses`, for schedulers that only issue GET (e.g. Vercel Cron, which auto-attaches `Authorization: Bearer <CRON_SECRET>` when the env var is literally named `CRON_SECRET`).
Applies pending SQL files under `ingestion-service/migrations/*.sql`. For platforms (e.g. Vercel) where the DB is only reachable from inside the platform's own network. Idempotent.
Recent sync runs (last 20) plus, if `business` is passed, that business's current sync state.

variable.description: Active business slug: afk | gak | gif | gakc | nh | per (or "all" where supported) — confirm live via 'List businesses'
Chat/meeting conversation id — leave blank to start a new one, then copy it from the first response
Set after calling 'Upload documents (ingest)' or 'List documents'
Set after calling 'Upload bills' or 'List bills'
Ingestion Service auth — matches CRON_SECRET env var
Alternate Ingestion Service auth — matches INTERNAL_API_TOKEN env var
